# Cleveland Cavaliers - I Think This Is Their BEST Chance [NBA]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-24, 33:47. https://youtu.be/rnq3118kfhY

## Summary

Josh Lloyd and Danny Cunningham of Locked On Cavs preview the 2026-27 Cleveland Cavaliers. Cleveland added Peyton Watson in a sign-and-trade, drafted Malik Thomas and signed Mario Hezonja. They lost Max Strus, Dennis Schroder, Kennedy Chandler... more precisely Keon Ellis and Dean Wade. The projected starters are Harden, Mitchell, Watson, Mobley and Allen. Josh thinks Watson's usage will drop but his minutes will be more stable. The bigger worry is front court depth behind Mobley and Allen, since Thomas Bryant is the only backup. Jaylen Tyson's year three and Evan Mobley's offensive growth are named as the swing factors. Danny predicts about 51 to 53 wins and says a hard travel stretch from December 23 to February 6 could wear on them.

## Rules and methods

- [15:40](https://youtu.be/rnq3118kfhY?t=940) A player who moves to a deeper team can lose usage and still gain fantasy value, because his minutes and role become more stable.
  > "I think his minutes stability rises quite"
- [28:02](https://youtu.be/rnq3118kfhY?t=1682) Hot shooting during a stretch when teammates are injured may not last once the rotation is healthy. Look for a bigger sample, around 45 to 50 games, before trusting it.
  > "I'd like to see it happen for more than 45 50 games in terms of that shooting"
- [31:11](https://youtu.be/rnq3118kfhY?t=1871) A long run of travel with no consecutive home or road games can wear a team down. That stretch of the schedule is worth noting.
  > "They're traveling basically every other day for a month and a half."
